# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Age:** Late teens (died young)  <sub>[v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v3 c14 P15](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0015), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby was a very handsome girl with long, beautiful yellow-golden braids, large bright-blue eyes, a brilliant complexion, and a plump, showy figure. Toward the end of her life, galloping consumption made her very thin, with hectically bright cheeks and transparently delicate hands. After her death, her white-clad body possessed a pure, consecrated beauty that was remembered in Avonlea for years.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P5](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0005), [v3 c14 P31](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0031)_

## Personality

Cheerful, good-tempered, and laughter-loving, Ruby frankly enjoyed the pleasant things of life. She was heavily preoccupied with romance and admirers, boasting frequently about her beaux and flirtations. Though often sentimental, shallow, and prone to hysterics, she possessed a genuine love for babies and held a deep affection for Herb Spencer. In her final days, she showed a vulnerable, childlike desire to live before finding peace.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c26 P6](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0006), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 c14 P37](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0037)_

## History

Ruby grew up in Avonlea as a schoolmate of Anne Shirley and Diana Barry. She attended Queen's Academy in the teacher's preparation class, earning her license alongside her friends. After graduating, she taught school at Carmody while returning home on weekends. She enjoyed a vibrant social life filled with numerous suitors, including Nelson Atkins, Wilbur Blair, and eventually Herb Spencer. During the winter, she suffered an attack of chest congestion that developed into galloping consumption. Unable to continue teaching, she hid her illness under a lively facade until her declining health forced her to accept the truth. She spent her final summer sharing intimate conversations with Anne in her garden before passing away peacefully in her sleep.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c19 P59](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0059), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056), [v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 c11 P8](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0008), [v3 c14 P2](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0002), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_
